content: {"praised":["Acting was good at best during the first season","Oahu looked like 1968, showing underdeveloped Waikiki","Hawaii Five-O is the longest running cop show","The show combined crisp script-writing with classic themes","The series had a unique police drama tone in the tropics"],"criticized":["Acting was terrible, especially with makeup issues","Producers failed to make Caucasians look Japanese","The show’s pacing and humor were lacking","The story and themes were underdeveloped","The episode previews were missing, affecting content quality"]}
